# teams_network_roaming_policy (Resource)

Manages the NetworkRoamingPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsNetworkRoamingPolicy / Get-CsTeamsNetworkRoamingPolicy / Set-CsTeamsNetworkRoamingPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsNetworkRoamingPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `allow_ip_video` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowIPVideo parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `media_bit_rate_kb` (Number) Maps to the -MediaBitRateKb parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
